title: Spatial Visualization
question_text: If you take away this piece, what remains?
explanation_script: If you take away this piece, what remains?
Here is a combined shape, and one piece being taken away.
Here are the five answer choices, A through E.
The correct answer is C.
Only the removed piece disappears -- the rest stays the same.
So the answer is C.
